the VRF from bovine heart tissue was purified to a single protein component, that this protein is an enzyme which hydrolyzes cyclic nucleotides and that this enzyme is a protein kinase.
The preparation of VRF was carried out in the following manner.

(a) the VRF is a particulate fraction of heart tissue that is composed of protein and phosphatide, (b) the VRF has a molecular weight of 1 million, (c) the VRF inhibits superprecipitation of actomyosin and (d) the VRF does not affect the ATPase activity of myosin or actomyosin.
